query: What kinds of expenses tend to get declined, and does it differ by department?

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Well-separated, interpretable categories of expense type; directly supports discovering which kinds of expenses get declined, the core of the query.

per_column.name: procurement_action_type
per_column.rationale: Interpretable process-stage categories that can be segmented on and compared against decline rates; associational and external to the focus.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: Clean binary (manual vs auto) with meaningful balance; a plausible driver of declines and easy to compare across departments.

per_column.name: ci_id_quality
per_column.rationale: Interpretable data-quality tiers with reasonable spread; poor/placeholder identifiers could associate with declines, an informative relationship.

per_column.name: asset_brand
per_column.rationale: Distinct, human-readable brand categories that can be grouped and compared against decline rates.

per_column.name: is_travel_related
per_column.rationale: Binary flag with meaningful split; travel vs non-travel is a natural, interpretable segment for exploring declines by department.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary presence indicator with a usable split; missing source linkage could associate with declines.

judge.rationale: The added columns are all external, associational variables with interpretable, well-separated categories or clean binaries, none of which merely restate the state_declined focus. asset_category, is_travel_related, and asset_brand directly enable segmenting 'what kinds of expenses get declined,' while entry_origin, ci_id_quality, and has_source_id surface data-provenance/quality hypotheses that can each be cross-tabulated with department. Categories have usable spread (no near-constant or hyper-fine-grained fields), making them well suited to human-driven relationship discovery. Slight deduction because several columns (procurement_action_type dominated by one value, has_source_id, ci_id_quality) are somewhat process/metadata oriented and moderately imbalanced, limiting comparative power, but as a set they strongly support the exploratory intent.
